notes.title: ‘Summer and Score Through the Doors’ demo is off
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the official studio of [b]‘Summer and Score Through the Doors’[/b], it's been a few weeks since we opened the demo, and we've received some feedback and support from players, so we'd like to thank you all!
Since this is the first time we've opened a demo for all to try out, please feel free to ask us any questions you may have.
At present, we will close the demo on May 26th, and rework the game to adjust and optimize it properly, and we hope to give you a better experience when we open the demo next time!

notes.title: ‘Summer and Score Through the Doors’ demo——v0.5.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Players,
This is the official ‘Summer and Score Through the Doors’.

We sincerely appreciate everyone who tried our early demo and provided valuable feedback. Based on your suggestions and identified bugs, we’ve made optimizations and adjustments. The current version, v0.5.5, includes the following updates:

[h2][b]Optimizations[/b][/h2]
1. Improved the gameplay experience in the first battle (tutorial level) of the Mathematics Chapter.
2. Enhanced two short story segments in the Physics Chapter.
3. Slightly adjusted stats for certain enemies.

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
1. Fixed an issue where hints in the team formation interface might not disappear.
2. Fixed a bug causing multiple boss models to appear simultaneously in the enemy intel section of the team formation screen.
3. Fixed an abnormal secondary growth rate for score objectives.
